name: Glenn Legend
caption: A 6 ft 5, 250 lb tweener who was the first wrestler the fed announced signing, on 2 December 2007; his profile gives Legend Status (an Unprettier) and Flawless Leap (a Green Bay Plunge) as finishers and the Legend Lock (an elevated Texas Cloverleaf) as his submission.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own news post as the first IWS star signed, on 2 December 2007; the profile page (legend.html) carries the stats and finishers, and its finisher names match the wrestler the news names.

name: Ryan Havoc
caption: A 6 ft 2, 220 lb face from Hollywood, CA, announced on 3 December 2007 as a former IWS Champion; his finishers are Havoc Time (a Shooting Star Press into a Frog Splash) and Perfection (a Death Valley Driver), with Punk'd (a Sharpshooter around the ring post) as his submission.

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own news post as announced on 3 December 2007 as a "former IWS Champion"; the profile page (havoc.html) carries the stats and finishers, and its finisher names match the wrestler the news names.

name: Brandon Gateman
caption: A 6 ft 4, 250 lb tweener from Toronto, Ontario, announced on 3 December 2007 as having joined the fed; his finisher is the BKO (an RKO) and his submission the Canadian Maple Leaf (a Texas Cloverleaf).

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own news post as announced on 3 December 2007 as having joined the IWS family; the profile page (gateman.html) carries the stats and finishers, and its finisher names match the wrestler the news names.

name: Ginger Snapps
caption: A 5 ft 3, 120 lb face from Hollywood, CA, announced on 3 December 2007 as having joined the fed; her finishers are Snap, Crackle and Pop (a Spinebuster into a pin) and To Sweet (a Chick Kick), and her submission is the Glam Life (a Mexican Surfboard).

tenures.source: Named in the fed's own news post as announced on 3 December 2007 as having joined the IWS family; the profile page (snapps.html) carries the stats and finishers, and its finisher names match the wrestler the news names.
